replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
Excellent!
It's completely optional, but just try to imagine how the map would be without diamond. Sometimes, they have much more of a fun, skillful experience. This map seems to be pushing it a little with the monuments being so close to land, but I'm sure it'll do just fine with them. Just for a future reference :3
Anyways, wonderful job-- it looks amazing! :D
I also love the picture listing all the stuff c:

replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
I love the aesthetics of this map! Really phenomenal structures and the side pattern is awesome too. The floor pattern is a bit plain although.
I like the layout of the map, but I dislike the blockyness of the shape of the islands in some parts. For example central island bit.

I would also like to point out that in your YAML that on line 3 "world: Christmas Mayhem" you can't have a space in the name for this. It should look like "world: ChristmasMayhem"
Im afraid i have to do this...
